reasoning: A universally recognizable question mark inside a circle representing questions, FAQs, quizzes, and help/support documentation. It fits tasks centered on preparing questions, writing FAQs or trivia, or managing help desk inquiries, though for specific topic inquiries the topic itself is a better icon.
